evals.prompt: We just finished the migration. Sync what we learned into memory so future sessions know.
evals.expected_output: Gathers state, picks the memory system, writes one fact per file with frontmatter and an index pointer, and verifies.
assertions: Gathers git log, diff stat, branch and status first
Picks the memory system that is present (project memory, Serena, claude-mem, .agents/memory)
One fact per file with required frontmatter and a one-line MEMORY.md pointer
Notes carry provenance and trust fields

evals.prompt: Remember the key points from this blog post I pasted about Kubernetes tuning.
evals.expected_output: Treats the content as external-derived and quarantines it.
assertions: Writes it to memory/quarantine/ with trust: quarantine so it stays out of RAG auto-injection until a human reviews
Does not delete an older superseded note; supersession is handled by valid_to

evals.prompt: Which of my memory notes are stale? Clean them up.
evals.expected_output: Auditing stale memory is memory-prune, not writing new memory.
assertions: Does not write a new memory note
Treats the task as an audit of existing entries
